Name: When Nature Calls - Immersive Bathroom Needs
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][b][size=6]When Nature Calls[/size][/b][/center]
[center]Eat. Drink. Carry Toilet Paper.[/center]

[center]When Nature Calls adds a lightweight bathroom-need system to Stardew Valley.[/center]
[center]There’s no visible meter, no complicated survival UI, and no constant interruptions.[/center]
[center]Just a hidden need that quietly builds as you eat and drink.[/center]
[center]Once your farmer starts feeling the pressure, you’ll get a warning.[/center]
[center]That’s your chance to prepare.[/center]
[center]Grab some [b]Toilet Paper[/b], finish what you’re doing, and decide whether it’s time to head home.[/center]
[center]You can use the bathroom in your farmhouse or cabin... or ask to use one while visiting an eligible NPC indoors.[/center]

[center]Now, Stardew Valley has never exactly shown us where everyone’s bathroom is.[/center]
[center]So where is it?[/center]
[center]Obviously...[/center]
[center][b]It’s at the back of the house.[/b][/center]
[center]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[/center]



⏳ [b]THE LONGER YOU HOLD IT...[/b]
Once Nature Calls, ignoring it won’t make it go away.
After that first warning, the pressure slowly builds on its own.
Every in-game hour you put it off pushes your farmer a little closer to [b]Desperate[/b] — even if you stop eating and drinking.
So that first warning really means something.
Finish that last crop? Sure.
One more mine floor? Maybe.
But keep pushing your luck...
and that calm walk home might suddenly become a sprint. 😅


🧻 [b]TOILET PAPER[/b]
Toilet Paper is a real item you can carry with you.
Craft it from:
[b]5 Fiber[/b]
or pick some up from [b]Pierre’s[/b] or [b]JojaMart[/b].
When you choose to use an indoor bathroom away from home, When Nature Calls handles the bathroom interaction and required Toilet Paper through [b]its own gameplay prompt and rules[/b].
If you don’t have Toilet Paper, the mod only tells you after you actually choose to use the bathroom.
😱 [b]WHEN YOU WAIT TOO LONG...[/b]
Ignore the warning long enough and your farmer becomes [b]Desperate[/b].
They’ll start moving a little faster...
because priorities have changed.
It creates those funny, panicked moments where you suddenly abandon whatever you were doing and rush home.
A little like the old Pokémon games when poison made you scramble back to the Pokémon Center...
except this time, the safe place is your bathroom.


💩 [b]NATURE’S ACCIDENT[/b]
If you don’t make it in time...
well.
You were warned.
A [b]Nature’s Accident[/b] leaves your farmer embarrassed, drained, and moving a little slower for the rest of the day.
It’s not devastating.
It’s just enough to make you think:
[b]I really should have gone earlier.[/b]


🧼 [b]SOAP & SCRUB INTEGRATION[/b]
If you also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52511][b]Soap & Scrub[/b][/url], accidents will naturally leave your farmer [b]Dirty[/b] too.
The two systems work together automatically while still remaining standalone.
Clean yourself up...
but the embarrassment may take a little longer to wear off.


🌾 [b]WHY WHEN NATURE CALLS?[/b]
When Nature Calls is meant to feel like a tiny mechanic that could have always existed in Stardew Valley.
No giant systems.
No bathroom maps.
No toilet furniture.
No visible needs bar.
Just:
[b]Eat → Drink → Nature Calls → Find a Bathroom[/b]
...or run.



📦 [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/*]
[/list]

💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
When Nature Calls is built around [b]Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems[/b] and does not depend on any other mod’s content.
Its mechanics use gameplay information already available through Stardew Valley, including eating and drinking, time progression, player location, indoor NPC interactions, movement, stamina, and the farmer’s current bathroom need.
When the player interacts with an eligible NPC indoors, When Nature Calls can show [b]its own separate bathroom-request prompt[/b].
That prompt is created and controlled entirely by When Nature Calls. [b]It does not alter, replace, generate, or copy the NPC’s own dialogue, character writing, portraits, sprites, schedules, or other source content.[/b]
Toilet Paper, need growth, warnings, bathroom prompts, Desperate mode, bathroom use, accidents, penalties, and recovery are controlled by [b]the mod’s own programmed rules and configuration[/b].
The optional Soap & Scrub integration only communicates the accident state between the two systems when both mods are installed.
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development of When Nature Calls, including development of the mod’s code.
Some UI/item artwork, including the [b]Toilet Paper / Nature’s Accident icon[/b], was created with AI generation based on original concepts made specifically for When Nature Calls.
The mod itself was designed, tested, balanced, adjusted, and assembled by me.
[b]When Nature Calls does not use AI, an LLM, or any other generative system while Stardew Valley is running.[/b]
Bathroom need, warnings, prompts, NPC interactions, accidents, Toilet Paper use, penalties, and other gameplay behaviour are controlled through predefined rules and programmed game logic.
AI does not generate NPC dialogue, responses, character content, bathroom requests, events, or other gameplay content at runtime.
